label: have something done
original: Someone is going to repair my car tomorrow.
explanation: HAVE + objeto + participio: otra persona hace el trabajo por vos. En continuo: 'I am having my car repaired'.

label: Pasiva en futuro
original: They will announce the results next week.
explanation: Pasiva con WILL: will + be + participio.

label: Pasiva impersonal (believe)
original: People believe that the painting is a fake.
explanation: Sujeto + is believed + to + infinitivo. Es la misma estructura que 'is said to be'.

label: Pasiva en present perfect
original: Nobody has cleaned this room for weeks.
explanation: 'Nobody has' pasa a negativo: has not been + participio.

label: Pasiva en pasado continuo
original: They were interviewing the singer when the lights went out.
gapped: The singer ___ when the lights went out.
explanation: Pasiva del pasado continuo: was/were + being + participio.

label: Pasiva con should have
original: Someone should have told me about the change.
explanation: Modal perfecto en pasiva: should + have been + participio.

label: have something done (pasado)
original: A mechanic checked the brakes for us before the race.
explanation: HAD + objeto + participio: el mecánico lo hizo por nosotros.

label: Pasiva impersonal en pasado
original: It is thought that the thieves escaped through a window.
gapped: The thieves ___ escaped through a window.
explanation: Para una acción pasada: is/are thought + TO HAVE + participio.

label: Pregunta indirecta con if
original: 'Can you help me with my homework?' Ben asked his sister.
gapped: Ben asked his sister ___ him with his homework.
explanation: Pregunta de sí/no indirecta: IF + sujeto + verbo, sin inversión. CAN pasa a COULD.

label: accuse someone of
original: 'You broke the vase, didn't you?' my mother said to me.
explanation: ACCUSE someone OF + -ing.

label: deny + -ing
original: 'I didn't take the money,' said Paul.
explanation: DENY + -ing (o having + participio). Nunca 'deny to take'.

label: advise someone to
original: 'You should see a doctor,' Sam told me.
explanation: ADVISE someone TO + infinitivo.

label: remind someone to
original: 'Remember to lock the door,' Dad told me.
explanation: REMIND someone TO + infinitivo.

label: offer to
original: 'I'll carry your bag for you,' said Liam.
explanation: OFFER TO + infinitivo, sin objeto de persona.

label: Pregunta indirecta con where
original: 'Where did you buy that jacket?' Ella asked me.
explanation: Pregunta indirecta: sin DID y con el verbo un paso atrás (bought → had bought).

label: refuse to
original: 'I won't lend you my car,' said Rosa.
explanation: REFUSE TO + infinitivo.

label: unless
original: I'll only go to the party if you come too.
gapped: I won't go to the party ___ too.
explanation: UNLESS = a menos que. 'won't go … unless you come'.

label: as long as
original: You can borrow my bike, but only if you bring it back by six.
gapped: You can borrow my bike ___ bring it back by six.
explanation: AS LONG AS = siempre y cuando.

label: Tercer condicional
original: I didn't know you were in hospital, so I didn't visit you.
gapped: If I ___ you were in hospital, I would have visited you.
explanation: Tercer condicional: IF + had + participio.

label: Tercer condicional negativo
original: Without the map, we would have got lost.
gapped: If we ___ the map, we would have got lost.
explanation: 'Without' = si no hubiéramos tenido: had not + had. HAD aparece dos veces: auxiliar y verbo.

label: Segundo condicional
original: He isn't tall enough to play basketball professionally.
gapped: If he ___, he could play basketball professionally.
explanation: Segundo condicional: IF + pasado. WERE es lo formal; WAS también se acepta.

label: in case
original: Take some money because you might need a taxi.
explanation: IN CASE + presente = por si acaso.

label: provided (that)
original: We'll have the picnic tomorrow if it doesn't rain.
gapped: We'll have the picnic tomorrow ___ rain.
explanation: PROVIDED (THAT) = siempre que. Va con presente.

label: wish + past perfect
original: I regret not buying that house.
explanation: Arrepentimiento sobre el pasado: WISH + past perfect.

label: not as … as
original: This exam was easier than I expected.
gapped: This exam was not ___ I expected.
explanation: Más fácil de lo esperado = no tan difícil como: NOT AS + adjetivo opuesto + AS.

label: Superlativo
original: I've never seen such a boring film.
explanation: Superlativo + present perfect con EVER: 'the most boring film I've ever seen'.

label: Superlativo de un adjetivo corto
original: She runs faster than anyone else in her class.
explanation: Más rápido que todos = el más rápido: THE + -EST + sustantivo.

label: not as … as (adjetivo largo)
original: Mark is less patient than his brother.
explanation: LESS … THAN equivale a NOT AS … AS.

label: Comparativo invertido
original: Train travel is cheaper than flying.
explanation: Se invierte el orden y el adjetivo: si A es más barato, B es más caro.

label: not as many … as
original: There were fewer people at the concert than we expected.
gapped: There were not ___ people at the concert as we expected.
explanation: Con contables plurales: NOT AS MANY … AS. Con incontables sería AS MUCH.

label: Posibilidad en el pasado
original: It's possible that she missed the bus.
explanation: Posibilidad sobre el pasado: MIGHT + have + participio.

label: Deducción negativa en presente
original: I'm sure he isn't telling the truth.
explanation: Seguridad negativa: CAN'T + be + -ing. MUSTN'T no se usa para deducir.

label: needn't have
original: It wasn't necessary for us to wait, but we did.
explanation: NEEDN'T HAVE + participio: lo hiciste, pero no hacía falta.

label: Ausencia de obligación
original: You are not obliged to wear a uniform.
explanation: DON'T HAVE TO = no es obligatorio. MUSTN'T significaría que está prohibido.

label: ought not to have
original: It was a bad idea to shout at him.
explanation: Crítica del pasado: OUGHT NOT TO HAVE + participio (= shouldn't have).

label: Posibilidad en el pasado (may)
original: Perhaps he forgot about our meeting.
explanation: PERHAPS + pasado = MAY + have + participio.

label: Obligación en pasiva
original: It's compulsory to wear a helmet on this site.
explanation: Obligación en pasiva: MUST + be + participio.

label: had better
original: It would be a good idea for you to apologise.
explanation: HAD BETTER + infinitivo sin TO = más te vale.

label: can't stand + -ing
original: I really hate it when people interrupt me.
explanation: CAN'T STAND + objeto + -ing = no soportar.

label: succeed in + -ing
original: He finally managed to fix the computer.
explanation: MANAGE TO = SUCCEED IN + -ing.

label: be allowed to
original: My parents didn't let me stay out late.
gapped: I ___ stay out late by my parents.
explanation: LET someone do = someone IS ALLOWED TO do (pasiva).

label: would rather
original: I'd prefer to stay at home tonight.
explanation: WOULD RATHER + infinitivo sin TO.

label: there's no point (in) + -ing
original: It's not worth arguing with him.
explanation: THERE'S NO POINT (IN) + -ing = no tiene sentido.

label: can't help + -ing
original: I couldn't stop laughing when I saw his hat.
gapped: I couldn't ___ when I saw his hat.
explanation: CAN'T HELP + -ing = no poder evitar.

label: be used to + -ing
original: Driving on the left still feels strange to me.
gapped: I am still not ___ on the left.
explanation: BE USED TO + -ing = estar acostumbrado. Distinto de USED TO + infinitivo (solía).

label: prevent someone from
original: We couldn't go out because of the heavy rain.
explanation: PREVENT someone FROM + -ing.

label: it's time + pasado
original: We should leave now.
explanation: IT'S TIME + sujeto + PASADO: se queja de que ya es hora.

label: have difficulty (in) + -ing
original: I find it hard to concentrate when it's noisy.
explanation: HAVE DIFFICULTY (IN) + -ing.

label: there's a good chance
original: She's very likely to win the competition.
explanation: THERE'S A GOOD CHANCE (THAT) + oración = es muy probable que.

label: despite + sustantivo
original: Although it was raining, they played the match.
explanation: ALTHOUGH + oración = DESPITE + sustantivo: 'despite the rain'.

label: have no interest in
original: I'm not interested in politics at all.
explanation: NOT INTERESTED = HAVE NO INTEREST; 'at all' refuerza la negación.

label: the fact that
original: He didn't apologise, which made me angry.
explanation: THE FACT THAT + oración funciona como sujeto: 'The fact that he didn't apologise…'.

label: the moment (= as soon as)
original: I'm going to call her as soon as I get home.
gapped: I'm going to call her the ___ home.
explanation: THE MOMENT = AS SOON AS, con presente para el futuro.

label: run out of
original: The shop has no milk left.
explanation: RUN OUT OF = quedarse sin algo.

label: take after
original: I resemble my grandfather.
explanation: TAKE AFTER = parecerse a un familiar mayor.

label: turn down
original: She rejected the job offer.
explanation: TURN DOWN = rechazar (una oferta, una invitación).

label: look up to
original: I really admire my older sister.
explanation: LOOK UP TO = admirar a alguien.

label: come up with
original: We need to think of a new plan.
gapped: We need to ___ a new plan.
explanation: COME UP WITH = ocurrírsele, idear.

label: get on with
original: How well do you get along with your neighbours?
explanation: GET ON (WELL) WITH = llevarse bien con alguien.

label: put off (pasiva)
original: They have postponed the meeting until Friday.
explanation: PUT OFF = posponer. En pasiva: has been put off.
